## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are experiencing. (e.g., "I'm always frustrated when...")

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of the feature or capability you would like to see implemented.

## Alternative Solutions Considered
A description of any alternative solutions, tools, or workarounds you've considered.

## Workflow / Use Case
Describe how this feature fits into a developer workflow (e.g., node interaction, agent task, or local execution).

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or diagrams regarding the request here.
